thread:
maria: quick sanity check on model catalog compare UX. found focus jump when pinning a version in the compare panel. repeating on mac/chrome.

sam: steps?

maria: select two models > Compare > click Pin on one row. keyboard focus moves out of the panel.

lee: likely a reparenting issue. are we moving the DOM node when a version is pinned?

maria: yes, pinned rows are visually lifted to the top by actually prepending the node. that breaks the activeElement.

kim: design preference is stable DOM + visual grouping. clone view for the pinned anchor could work if clone is inert.

sam: engineering notes: clone must be aria-hidden + tabindex=-1, and map hover/clicks back to original via pointer-events none or event delegation. simpler: keep DOM and use CSS sticky + box-shadow.

ux-bot: accessibility reminder: moving interactive elements can confuse screen readers. announce pin state via a role=status live region: "Pinned: v2.1".

maria: also saw perf badge tooltip clipped inside compare. fix by mounting tooltip to body or set overflow visible.

kim: copy tweak: button label "Pin" + tooltip "Pin 14 Keep this model version visible in comparisons" (short).

sam: i'll prototype stable DOM + CSS sticky and add aria-live status text. tagging @maria for QA once ready.
